items.duty_text: Maintain records of the number of crashes each licensed driver has been involved in while operating a commission-licensed vehicle.
Suspend the taxicab or for-hire vehicle driver’s license for up to thirty days when the specified six-point threshold is met.
Revoke the taxicab or for-hire vehicle driver’s license when the specified ten-point threshold is met.
Suspend the taxicab or for-hire vehicle driver’s license for up to thirty days when the combined point threshold is met, subject to the specified safety-violation limitation.
Revoke the taxicab or for-hire vehicle driver’s license when the combined point threshold is met, subject to the specified safety-violation limitation.
Suspend the taxicab or for-hire vehicle driver’s license for up to thirty days when the specified DMV or equivalent-agency six-point threshold is met.
Revoke the taxicab or for-hire vehicle driver’s license when the specified DMV or equivalent-agency ten-point threshold is met.
Do not issue taxicab driver’s licenses or for-hire vehicle driver’s licenses.
Do not renew taxicab driver’s licenses or for-hire vehicle driver’s licenses.
Revoke the driver's license of a driver found to have violated the specified provisions three or more times within a thirty-six month period.

items.duty_text: Restrict issuance of new for-hire vehicle licenses until completion of the specified study or August 31, 2019, whichever occurs first.
items.deadline_text: through the completion of study on the impact of growth in the taxicab and for-hire vehicle industries, or August 31, 2019, whichever occurs first

items.duty_text: Issue new for-hire vehicle licenses only when the vehicle will affiliate with an eligible base station that has not reached the statutory maximum.
Review each request for a charge proposed by an app-based for-hire service and approve it only if the statutory conditions are satisfied.
Set minimum prices for services provided by for-hire vehicle drivers who are independent contractors.
The commission shall inspect proof of correction, determine whether the violation was corrected, and recommend dismissal to the tribunal when appropriate.

Engage in outreach and education efforts informing individuals considering purchase, rental, lease, or loan arrangements for for-hire vehicles, and individuals considering purchase, refinancing, or leasing a taxicab license, about the costs and benefits of those arrangements and transactions.
Provide access to counseling intended to help individuals understand the terms of the specified arrangements and transactions.

Make educational materials available in English, the six languages most commonly spoken by limited English proficient individuals as determined by the Department of City Planning, and any other languages the commission determines appropriate.
Make the educational materials available on the commission's website.

items.duty_text: Examine and address issues related to racism and discrimination in the for-hire vehicle industry.
Develop policies and best practices to ensure greater representation of drivers from underserved communities.
Develop and implement driver trainings addressing anti-discrimination and cultural sensitivity toward passengers and prospective passengers, including disability-related best practices.
Assess the feasibility of a driver-to-driver mentorship and cultural awareness program.
Promote ways to encourage equitable treatment of drivers by other drivers.
Expand public awareness regarding service refusals by drivers, including through public awareness campaigns and community outreach.
Establish mechanisms for passengers and prospective passengers to submit complaints directly to the commission.
Ensure that service refusal complaints are processed by the appropriate authorities.
Serve as a resource supporting the needs of persons with disabilities in receiving services from commission-licensed vehicles.
Before issuing a taxicab broker license or renewal, investigate and assess each applicant's good character, honesty, and integrity, considering the statutory criteria.
On renewal of a taxicab broker license, reassess the applicant's character, honesty, and integrity using the statutory criteria.
Before issuing a taxicab agent license or renewal, investigate and assess each applicant's good character, honesty, and integrity, considering the statutory criteria.
On renewal of a taxicab agent license, reassess the applicant's character, honesty, and integrity using the statutory criteria.
Before issuing a taxicab license or renewal, investigate and assess each applicant's good character, honesty, and integrity, considering the statutory criteria.
On renewal of a taxicab license, reassess the applicant's character, honesty, and integrity using the statutory criteria.
Conduct a study on costs, challenges, and opportunities related to increasing the use of electric for-hire vehicles and installing new charging infrastructure.
